# تقدر (Tagdar)

> منصة تعليمية عربية تجمع نخبة المدرّبين في مسارات تعليمية متدرّجة، وتُنهيها بشهادات معتمدة تضيف وزناً حقيقياً إلى المسار المهني.

Tagdar is an Arabic-language online learning platform. Learners browse structured
tracks, study at their own pace with lifetime access, and finish with an
accredited certificate.

## Main pages

- [الرئيسية / Home](/): platform overview, learning fields, featured courses.
- [الدورات / Courses](/courses): browse and filter the full course catalogue.
- [المدونة / Blog](/blogs): articles and practical guides.
- [من نحن / About](/about-us): the platform's mission and approach.
- [انضم كمدرّب / Become an instructor](/become-instructor): how to teach on Tagdar.
- [تواصل معنا / Contact](/contact-us): get in touch.

## Account

- [تسجيل الدخول / Login](/login): sign in to a learner account.
- [إنشاء حساب / Register](/register): create an account to start learning.

## Notes

- Primary language is Arabic (RTL). Interface copy is Modern Standard Arabic.
- TODO(client): links are relative — switch to absolute URLs once the production
  domain is final.
